sens_en: to pinch, to mould, to make up
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : à gauche, 扌, la main ; à droite, 日 posé sur 土, la terre, qui forment 圼, lu niè. 圼 a la syllabe de 捏 : il donne le son, la main donne le sens. La main pétrit une boule de terre au soleil : pincer, modeler, et inventer de toutes pièces, 捏造.
origine_en: As a memory aid: on the left, 扌, the hand; on the right, 日 set on 土, earth, which together make 圼, read niè. 圼 has the syllable of 捏: it gives the sound, while the hand gives the meaning. The hand kneads a ball of clay in the sun: to pinch, to mould, and to make things up, 捏造.
